title.S: Server Is Up, App Is Down

issue.S: The Growth engineering team says the internal ByteGeist status app at http://10.0.2.25 is unreachable from the ops jumphost. The EC2 instance i-0bytegeist123 is still visible in the console and other apps on the same VPC are fine, so they suspect networking or a security group change.

objective.S: Investigate reachability layer by layer: EC2 instance state, security group rules, network path, and the application service itself. Identify which layer is actually broken and recommend a fix that matches that layer — do not blame AWS networking without evidence.

expectedDiagnosis.S: The EC2 instance is running and healthy, the security group permits TCP 80 from the VPC, and 10.0.2.25 is reachable at the network layer (ping succeeds). HTTP fails with Connection refused because the bytegeist-web service on the instance is stopped — nothing is listening on port 80. The problem is the application layer, not AWS networking.

expectedSolution.S: Start the bytegeist-web service on the instance (systemctl start bytegeist-web), verify it stays active and is listening on port 80, and ensure it is enabled so it starts automatically on boot. Do not modify the security group, EC2 instance state, or VPC routing — those layers are already correct.
